0.1.0.description:
First public build of the Big Walk randomizer. **Alpha**: every path works in game, on one machine and on two, but no seed has been played from first check to goal yet.

## Randomized
-   **Locations**: 45 puzzle gourds, 25 big-key cuts and the key deposits, 7 radio stations, gourd deposits into the monuments.
-   **Items**: gourds, big keys, the doors they used to open (drawbridge, map room, chairlift, train, tunnels, chapel, hub secret door), each station's music, and the island's gadgets as filler.
-   **Goals**: Gauntlet bell (default), chapel bell, second ending behind the Hub Secret Door, or a number of gourd deposits.

## Co-op
-   Big Walk is co-op, and so is this: both bells and every monument deposit need two players.
-   One co-op group = **one** Archipelago slot. Only the host types address, slot and password, on the hosting screen.
-   Everyone installs the mod. A friend without it can join, but sees a vanilla-looking world.
-   AP status, goal, item feed and radio music reach every player.
-   Universal Tracker supported, no YAML needed.

## Setup
-   **Every player**: extract the zip into the Big Walk folder, launch **through Steam**. First launch = 1-2 min of black screen while BepInEx downloads Unity's libraries, so be online.
-   **Whoever generates**: `bigwalk.apworld` into `custom_worlds`, one YAML per co-op group.
-   No separate client: the mod checks the connection before a new game starts.
-   Full guide: [SETUP.md](https://github.com/Grizfreak/BigWalk-archipelago/blob/v0.1.0/SETUP.md)

## Heads up
-   Requires Archipelago **0.6.7+**.
-   Traps do nothing yet (option defaults to 0%).
-   Keep the same host for a whole seed: the save lives on their machine.
-   Tested on Big Walk 1.5.1 with the bundled BepInEx 6.0.0-be.781.
-   Bug reports: `BepInEx/LogOutput.log` from the host, and from any player who saw the problem.

## License
-   The mod and the apworld are MIT. The zip also bundles BepInEx, Doorstop, Il2CppInterop and the .NET runtime under their own licenses: see `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt`.
0.1.0.title: Big Walk Archipelago 0.1.0

0.1.1.description:
## Big Walk Archipelago 0.1.1 (alpha)

Update both files: the mod zip for every player, the apworld for whoever generates.

### Added
- `lock_arch_doors` option: the hub's arch doors can be items.
- Radio stations numbered by their light on the dial (`Radio Station 01: Bobby` … `07: Bristol`).
- Received gourds come in the six Archipelago colours, the same on every screen.

### Changed
- Received items go to each player in turn (free hands first), not always to the host.
- Goals renamed after the game's achievements: `big_wall`, `big_goodbye` (default), `big_game`, `big_collection`. Old names still work.
- Puzzle locations all end in "Puzzle"; "Spawn Secret Door" and "Big Wall Door" replace "Hub Secret" and "Chapel".

### Fixed
- A player could become unable to pick anything up after a sealed-box puzzle.
- Belts showed a second, floating belt and could not hold anything.
- Gourds could turn glowing white, or differ between players.
- Puzzle gourds stored in a bag reappeared at spawn on every load.
- Opening a save with Archipelago off, then an Archipelago save in the same session, could send all of the first save's checks.
- A save played with Archipelago off got mod data written into it.

0.1.0 seeds still work with this mod; the new names and options need a seed generated with the 0.1.1 apworld.
0.1.1.title: Big Walk Archipelago 0.1.1

0.1.2.description:
## Big Walk Archipelago 0.1.2 (alpha)

Update both files: the mod zip for every player, the apworld for whoever generates. **Everyone in a session must run the same build of the mod.**

### Added
- `lock_puzzle_needs` option (off by default): what a puzzle is built from becomes an item. Buttons, Synchronized Buttons, Icon / Drawing / Pose / Sound / Point Panels, Speakers, Lights, Teapots, Timed Tomato, Golf Ball, Big Head Mask, Ink Viewer, Counter, Coordinates Computer and Eggs are not on the island until their item arrives, then they appear for every player. No puzzle is ever behind an item of its own.
- `start_with_random_puzzle_need` (on by default) gives one random part at the start so a tutorial puzzle is always doable, and `start_with_puzzle_needs` lists parts to start with.
- A line in the corner says which puzzle parts are still missing, for the host and its guests.
- `start_with_arch_doors_open` option: any of the hub's arch doors, the first one included, can be an item. It replaces `lock_arch_doors`.
- A session journal, `BepInEx/session-journal.tsv`: every item, check and opened part with the time and where you stood. Send it with a bug report.

### Changed
- A big key received while you play goes into somebody's hands, like a gourd, instead of landing in front of whoever the mod picked.
- The channel between a host and its guests changed: a guest on another build ignores its host and sees every part.

### Fixed
- Archipelago 0.6.7 read the apworld as version 0.0.0 and rejected any YAML with a `requires` line.

### Known limits
- The Silent Gauntlet and the end of the game are left alone: their parts are never hidden.
- Tested on one PC with a second local instance, not on two machines.

0.1.1 seeds still work with this mod; the new options need a seed generated with the 0.1.2 apworld.
0.1.2.title: Big Walk Archipelago 0.1.2

0.3.0.description:
## Big Walk Archipelago 0.3.0 (alpha)

Update both files: the mod zip for every player, the apworld for whoever generates. **Everyone in a session must run the same build of the mod.**

### Heads-up for your YAML
- `lock_puzzle_needs` is now **on by default**: the parts puzzles are built from are items to find.
- `gourd_slot_checks` is now `gourd_sanity`, `radio_checks` is now `radio_sanity`. The old names fall back to the defaults: rename them.
- The towers' keys and checks use the names players use: Red Funnel, Green Cup, Blue Castle, Yellow Twist, Black Monolith, Green Dome. A YAML or plando naming them needs the new names.
- The options are sorted into five groups: Goal, Sanity, Logic, QoL, Puzzle QoL.

### Added
- **The Silent Gauntlet** (`gauntlet_mode: locked_stages`): each of the seven stages is a check, and its way up is an item: seven Progressive Gauntlet Doors by default, or one door per stage with `gauntlet_stage_items: individual`. `gauntlet_puzzles_required`, `gauntlet_stages_local` and `lock_gauntlet_needs` shape it; the puzzle parts inside the stages are hidden like the rest of the island's.
- **Teleport buttons** (`teleport_buttons`: off, free, with_towers, items): buttons in the hub to the Red, Green, Blue, Yellow and Black towers and the Silent Gauntlet. `with_towers` opens one when you have opened the place on foot; `items` also needs its Teleporter. `teleport_back_to_hub` adds a way back in each place.
- **Resync stations replace Ctrl+R**: a button in the hub (and in each tower with `tower_resync_stations`) brings back your gourds, keys and gadgets lying around, with a light switch to leave the gadgets out and a sign saying what it does. Host only unless `guests_can_resync`; one resync at a time.
- **Cabin Fever waits**: `cabin_fever_time` and `cabin_fever_long_time` (vanilla, reduced, random_between, fixed), and a hidden help button in each house that takes ten seconds off.
- **Tile Thief** (`tile_thief`): a button beside the puzzle that makes new tiles in front of it, the expected ones (`easy`) or every kind it draws from (`chaos`).
- **`open_black_tower`** (on by default): the Black Tower's door is open from the start.
- **`require_arch_doors`** (on by default): what lies past the Left and Right Arch Doors needs that door in logic. The doors can still be walked round, but until one arrives what is past it stays out of logic, in the tracker too. The end of the game never needs them.
- **`hint_keys: from_start`**: the seven big keys are hinted from the first minute.
- **A new save gets its deposits back**: the server remembers how many gourds you placed.

### Fixed
- A save connected to another seed or slot no longer sends the previous one's checks.
- A big key no longer flies out of its stone when its monument fills before its item arrives.
- A big key already in its plinth stays there when its item arrives (the drawbridge went back up).
- Universal Tracker rebuilds the seed with every option that shapes it.
- The "skip this challenge" panels show once their puzzle's parts have arrived.
- A guest now sees what a player who picked something up before it joined is holding.

### Known limits
- Three and four players were tried with a second local instance only.

0.1.2 seeds still play with this mod; the new options need a seed generated with the 0.3.0 apworld.

0.4.0.description:
## Big Walk Archipelago 0.4.0 - Deathlink Update

Update both files: the mod zip for every player, the apworld for whoever generates. **Everyone in a session must run the same build of the mod.**

### Heads-up for your YAML
- **One option change breaks a 0.3 YAML:** `cabin_fever_time`, `cabin_fever_long_time` and their `_seconds_min` / `_seconds_max` are gone. Use `cabin_fever_seconds` (300 is the game's own wait) and `cabin_fever_long_seconds` (1800). For a random wait, Archipelago's own syntax: `cabin_fever_seconds: random-range-60-300`.
- **The defaults make a bigger seed:** 117 locations instead of 93 (12 packs, 8 fireworks, 4 flare guns), a quarter of the filler as bonuses, and colors drawn per seed. `pack_sanity`, `firework_sanity`, `flare_gun_sanity`, `bonus_fill_percentage` and `random_colors` turn them off.
- **Some settings are not in the YAML:** they are in the game, **Settings > Archipelago**.

### Added
- **More checks:** the island's 12 backpacks, belts and carton (`pack_sanity`), its 8 firework launchers (`firework_sanity`) and its 4 flare guns (`flare_gun_sanity`). The flare guns come back as items, and a **Rainbow Flare Gun** whose shots flicker through every color is in every pool.
- **Random colors** (`random_colors`): five to ten colors drawn per seed paint the island's buoys and flare guns, the same on every screen. Only objects of the map: never the players, the gourds or the keys.
- **Traps and bonuses** that hit every player: Big Drop, Big Throw, Big Trip, Big Meeting, Big Night, Big Sleep, Big Load, Big Mask and Big Flare; Big Speed, Big Jump and Big Day. 0 % traps and 25 % bonuses by default; `trap_weights`, `bonus_weights`, `hard_traps` and `trap_duration` (20 s) shape them.
- **TrapLink** (`trap_link`): the traps you receive are sent to the other games, and theirs play here.
- **DeathLink**, sent when a puzzle is failed (add `big_fall` for falls), received as a knock-out by default (everyone drops what they hold, loses their packs and is dazed), or as a drop, or a roulette of traps. `death_link_amnesty`, `death_link_target: one_player` and `death_link_trap_on_send` shape it.
- **In-game settings** (Settings > Archipelago): the overlay's text size, DeathLink on or off and its amnesty (the host), **Gentle effects** for photosensitive players (hides the traps' flashes on that screen), and the gourd name (the host names the gourds for everyone).
- **Pool options:** `island_object_limits` (the most of each island object, flare guns included) and `backpacks_in_pool`, `belts_in_pool`, `gourd_cartons_in_pool`.

### Known limits
- The gourd name is only in the mod's own screens: the server, the Text Client and the other games still say "Gourd".
- A Big Flare shot drifts a little forward as a real one does.
- Nobody has yet played a seed from the first check to the goal.

0.3.0 seeds still play with this mod; the new options need a seed generated with the 0.4.0 apworld.
0.4.0.title: Big Walk Archipelago 0.4.0

0.5.0.description:
## Big Walk Archipelago 0.5.0 (alpha)

Update both files: the mod zip for every player, the apworld for whoever generates. **Everyone in a session must run the same build of the mod** (the channel to the guests changed).

### Heads-up for your YAML
- **A 0.4 YAML generates as it did** (except `goal: big_wall` with `gauntlet_mode: locked_stages`, now refused), with one difference: `tower_sanity` is on by default and adds 7 checks (the towers reached). Turn it off for the 0.4 count.
- The new options need a seed generated with the 0.5.0 apworld; a 0.4 seed keeps playing with this mod.

### Added
- **Objectives** (`objectives`): things to do on the way to your goal, in any order, shown on a board in the hub and, if you like, on the overlay (Settings > Archipelago > Objectives on screen): `big_collection` (gourds), `big_keys`, `big_radio` (stations), `big_towers` (towers filled), `big_climb` (the island's highest point), `big_fiesta` (a party on the beach: a radio plugged into the big speakers, with a music playing). **`random_objectives`** draws a number of them, from your list or from all. The `goal` is the run's ending: **`big_wall` is now a goal for a short seed** (the chapel bell, no Gauntlet), besides `big_goodbye` and `big_game`. `lock_endings_until_objectives` keeps the ending (the bell, the Gauntlet's last door, the secret printer) shut until the rest is done. The climb and the party wait for every player to be there (`everyone_gathers`, on by default).
- **Towers in order** (`tower_mode`): `in_order` (the monuments take gourds one at a time, in an order the seed draws; a closed tower's button disappears and its monument refuses a gourd) and `by_item` (each monument also needs a **Progressive Monument**; `first_tower_open: false` starts with none open). The logic is exact. The overlay says which tower is open; the board in the hub names only the full ones and the open one.
- **Tower checks and hints** (`tower_sanity`, `hint_discovered_key_locations`, `hint_discovered_deposit_boxes`): reaching a tower is a check, and hints what waits at its key cuts, its key deposit and its monument. The drawbridge and the Green Dome, which have no button, count as reached when a player gets there.
- **Sounds:** a cowbell when an item arrives, a plinth for a check, the game's confetti for an objective done, a large cowbell for a DeathLink or a trap, on every screen. **Settings > Archipelago > Archipelago alerts** turns the text and the sound on or off.
- **`gourd_name`** now renames the gourds on the server too (Text Client, trackers, other games, spoiler). Letters, digits, spaces and a few signs; the rest is dropped.
- Lines on the screen for what happened: DeathLink sent, received and forgiven, a Big Trip with nowhere to go, the Settings overriding the seed.

### Changed
- The overlay keeps "Archipelago: Connected" and what arrives; the puzzle parts missing are no longer listed.
- **X-Ray Goggles** are now the **Scanner**. The Eggs need is shown as **Terrain Pegs** (the YAML key stays `eggs`). DeathLink and its amnesty are one row in Settings.

### Fixed
- Big Trip and Big Meeting spare the Gauntlet again.
- A lamp of the island no longer shines in another colour than its body once switched on.

### Known limits
- The party counts when a radio is tuned on a station you own, or when the music is heard by the host.

0.6.0.description:
## Big Walk Archipelago 0.6.0 (alpha)

Update both files: the mod zip for every player, the apworld for whoever generates. **Everyone in a session must run the same build of the mod** (the channel to the guests changed).

### Heads-up for your YAML
- **A 0.5 YAML generates almost as it did:** the new options are off by default, except `monument_sanity` (7 more checks; turn it off for the 0.5 count) and `lock_endings_until_objectives` (now on).
- The new options need a seed generated with the 0.6.0 apworld; a 0.5 seed keeps playing with this mod.
- The joke filler items are gone, so their names (Boid, Plumbus...) are free for `gourd_name`.
- The hidden `lock_arch_doors` of 0.1.1 is gone: use `start_with_arch_doors_open`.

### Added
- **Your body is an item** (`lock_abilities`: `handed` or `ambidextrous`): **Legs** (jump, crouch), **Seat** (chairs and the floor), **Progressive Arm** (raise, point, extend), **Throwing**, **Carrying** another player, and **Running** with `lock_running`. Every player of the slot gets them at once. The gesture puzzles ask for what they use.
- **Objects as checks** (`object_sanity`: `first_pickup` or `every`): the island's gadgets stay on the map and picking them up sends checks. `object_sanity_kinds` picks the kinds, `object_sanity_items` what their checks may hold (`any`, `local`, `junk`).
- **Lights as checks** (`light_sanity`: `lamps` or `lamps_and_switches`): the first time each lamp (and wall switch) is switched on.
- **Monuments full as checks** (`monument_sanity`), and **`linear_towers`**: a full monument gives its tower's key, as in the game.
- **The game's own ways, as options:** `linear_keys` (a placed key opens its door), `linear_puzzles` (each puzzle holds a gourd), `start_with_map_room_open`, `include_big_game_puzzles` (`from_start`, `when_unlocked`, `disabled`), `cut_key_sanity` (`on`, `junk`, `off`).
- **Objectives** `big_lights`, `big_objects` and `big_body`, each at a share you choose.
- **Traps:** **Big Silence** (everyone muted for a while), **Big Slide** (slippery ground), **Big Time** (a clock on your own computer's time, to keep).
- **`fast_golf`**: the golf ball is no longer too heavy.
- A short line on screen for every check sent: what, what it gave, to whom.

0.6.1.description:
## Big Walk Archipelago 0.6.1 (alpha)

**Apworld only:** replace `bigwalk.apworld` on the machine that generates. The 0.6.0 mod stays as it is, and 0.6.0 seeds keep playing.

### Fixed
- Seeds with the `big_fiesta` objective could be impossible to finish: the radio it needs was sometimes missing from the pool.
- Generation could fail with the vanilla options (`linear_puzzles`, `linear_keys`, `linear_towers`) or local object/light checks: the tutorial had no room left for the way out. When that happens now, you start with the item instead, and the generation log says so.
- Universal Tracker could not rebuild seeds made with `linear_keys` or `linear_puzzles`.

0.7.0.description:
## Big Walk Archipelago 0.7.0 (alpha)

Update both files: the mod zip for every player, the apworld for whoever generates. **Everyone in a session must run the same build of the mod.**

### Heads-up for your YAML
- **A 0.6 YAML generates as it did**: the new options are off by default, except `hint_board` (on, it changes no check).
- The twelve new traps are in `trap_weights` at 10 like the others; traps stay off by default (`trap_fill_percentage: 0`). Big Air and Big Reset are hard traps.
- The new options need a seed generated with the 0.7.0 apworld; a 0.6 seed keeps playing with this mod.

### Added
- **Twelve traps**: Big Ghost (everyone white), Big Paint (colours swapped), Big Air (up in the air), Big Goggles (narrow view), Big Pixels, Big Head, Big Brain (heads as lit lamps), Big Arms (big hands), Big Smell (green gas, players pushed apart), Big Brother (everyone small), Big Reset (the nearest unsolved puzzle starts again), Big Break (everyone sat on a folding chair).
- **The hub's notice board**: `hint_board` (on) shows your hint points and lets you write an item's name to ask for a hint; `tracker_board` counts and names the checks you can do now.
- **`map_tracker`**: the Map Room's big map shows every check left, in logic or all of them.
- **`linear_arch_doors`**: the hub's arch doors opened by their own buttons, as in the game.
- **`cabin_fever_hide_timer`** (and the long one): the Cabin Fever dial reads "??:??", now and then flashing a digit.
- The Gourd Carton follows `gourd_name` ("<name> Carton").

### Changed
- **Gentle effects** now also spares Big Goggles, Big Pixels, Big Smell's gas and Big Brain's light on that player's screen.
- The mod's `.cfg` holds only the player's settings; the debug tools moved to a file of their own.
- Every option is described on the game page.
- Fixed few stutters that could occur

0.7.1.description:
## Big Walk Archipelago 0.7.1 (alpha)

Update both files: the mod zip for every player, the apworld for whoever generates. **Everyone in a session must run the same build of the mod** (the host's channel to its guests changed).

### Heads-up for your YAML
- **With `object_sanity` or `light_sanity` on**, 75% of their checks now hold junk with `*_items: any` (`object_sanity_junk_percentage`, `light_sanity_junk_percentage`; 0 gives back the 0.7.0 behaviour).
- Otherwise a 0.7.0 YAML generates as it did; `zone_locks` is off by default.

### Added
- **`zone_locks`**: with Object or Light Sanity, the island's lamps and gadgets locked by the zone of the nearest coloured tower, 8 items (`Red Zone Lamps`, `Red Zone Gadgets`, and the same for green, blue and yellow). A zone's gadgets are off the map until its item arrives; its lamps and light switches stay usable but are out of logic until then. `start_with_zone_locks` and `zone_locks_local` too.
- **`object_sanity_junk_percentage`** and **`light_sanity_junk_percentage`**.
- **Big Brother** now pitches the voices up while everyone is small.

### Changed
- A seed with only a `goal` shows it as its one objective, on the overlay and on the hub's board.

### Fixed
- `junk` for Object or Light Sanity could not be kept in a big pool: past the gadgets' limits the filler was all bonuses. The gadgets now go past their limits.
- The YAML template describes all 24 traps.
- A rare generation failure with `linear_keys` and `linear_towers` together is rarer.

1.0.0.description:
## Big Walk Archipelago 1.0.0

Update both files: the mod zip for every player, the apworld for whoever generates. **Everyone in a session must run the same build of the mod** (the host's channel to its guests changed).

### Heads-up for your YAML
- **`custom_tiles` is on by default** (`matching_games`): when a game of your multiworld has a drawing of its own (Celeste, Zelda, Minecraft, Hollow Knight...), some of the puzzles' basic tiles show it. The puzzles ask for the same tiles. `custom_tiles: off` keeps the game's.
- `pack_sanity`, `flare_gun_sanity` and `linear_towers` were on/off and have more values now; `true` and `false` still mean what they meant. Otherwise a 0.7 YAML generates as it did.

### Added
- **Custom tiles**, drawn by the community: the nine basic peg tiles shown as other drawings, on every tile, split-flap and display, the same on every player's screen.
  - `custom_tiles`: `off`, `matching_games` (the default: the drawings of the games in the multiworld join the game's tiles), `matching_first` (every one of them shown, the game’s tiles in the places left), `all`, or `custom_only`. A game matches whatever the capitals (TUNIC, Starcraft 2, a Manual’s name...); Archipelago logo is in every multiworld.
  - `custom_tile_choices`: the tiles you want for sure, e.g. `[pokeball, heart, cat]`.
  - `custom_tile_weights`: how often each one is drawn.
  - `custom_drawings`: the community's scribbles for the drawing panels (none yet).
  - Want to add your own? See `mod/assets/tiles/README.md`.
- **`pack_sanity: junk`** and **`flare_gun_sanity: junk`**: the same checks, holding only filler or a trap.
- **`pack_sanity: vanilla`**: each pack's check gives the pack itself, which stays in your hands.
- **`linear_towers: one_deposit_box`**: a tower's key comes once its monument holds a number of gourds drawn for each tower, at its own "Monument Key" check.

### Fixed
- Peg tiles hidden by a puzzle part could fall off their racks when their item came.
- The seed's colors keep the order they were drawn in.
- The `junk` options leave the progression enough room: some tight seeds failed to generate.

### Thanks
The tiles are drawn by **Jack5**, **Don Chalant**, **GameFraek** and **Kensufox**, under CC BY 4.0. Thank you!

1.0.1.description:
## Big Walk Archipelago 1.0.1

A fix for the mod, from the first 1.0 sessions. **Update the mod zip for every player.** The world did not change: a seed made with 1.0.0 plays as it is, including one already started.

### Fixed
- **The Green Dome's door stayed shut** while its monument was the one taking gourds (the game opens it once the Black Tower is complete). With `tower_mode: in_order` or `by_item`, a seed that drew the Green Dome before the Black Tower had no monument taking gourds at all. The mod now opens the door at the Green Dome's turn, and from the start with `all_open`. A stuck seed opens again as soon as the host runs 1.0.1.
- **A player who fell could not get up** with Legs and Seat both locked (`lock_abilities`): jump and sit now always stand you up from the ground.
- A raised arm pointing, with pointing locked, still showed a T-pose and its sound on your own screen.

### Added
- The host gets a warning on screen when the seed was made with a **newer** apworld than the mod: update the mod, or the seed may not be finishable. A seed from an older apworld still plays as it was generated (without the newer options, custom tiles among them).
